_comment: scripts/05-install-mcp.sh does this for you (with a backup first).
This is the LOCAL configuration: comfyui-mcp auto-detects the ComfyUI
install path and probes port 8188, then 8000. Nothing else is needed.
Do NOT set COMFYUI_API_KEY unless you want Comfy Cloud - it switches the
server into cloud mode and local-only tools then fail with CLOUD_UNSUPPORTED.
